name: Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited
summary: Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, produces and sells float, automobile, construction, and other glass products for commercial and industrial applications. The company operates through three segments: Float Glass, Automobile Glass, and Architectural Glass. It provides automobile rubber and plastic components; manufactures electronic glass, plastic products, and low-e products; trades in automobile glass; and engages in the research and trading of glass, as well as mining activities.
